exposure: Policy preventing scheduled repeat cesarean deliveries before 39 weeks
outcome: Proportion of deliveries at less than 39 weeks
cohort: 213 women who underwent repeat cesarean deliveries, 112 before and 101 after a policy change preventing scheduled repeat cesarean deliveries at less than 39 weeks
finding: While there was a 12.1% absolute decrease in documented scheduled early-term deliveries after the policy change, there was no significant change (6.4% absolute decline) when using best obstetric dating.
